redfin.remarks: Welcome to 1847 Thrush Rd, a charming mountain retreat located in the serene town of Wrightwood. This well-maintained home offers a warm cabin feel with modern conveniences, creating the perfect balance of comfort and style. The property features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a cozy fireplace , spacious deck , attractive landscaping , an attached one-car garage, and a good-sized backyard ideal for enjoying the mountain setting. The home includes smart home features that allow you to control the heating and air conditioning remotely, ensuring comfort upon arrival. Additional upgrades include new toilets, updated lighting, a new security system, a new kitchen sink, and a newer septic tank installed just a couple of years ago. A whole-house water purification system provides added peace of mind. Conveniently located just minutes from local ski resorts , outdoor recreation, and all that Wrightwood has to offer, this property is well-suited for full-time living or a weekend getaway.
